class.name: WebFlexContainer
class.brief_description: A container that lays out child controls like CSS flexbox.
class.description: [WebFlexContainer] arranges child [Control] nodes using the same main flexbox properties as browser CSS: [member flex_direction], [member flex_wrap], [member justify_content], [member align_items], [member align_content], [member row_gap], and [member column_gap]. Each child can override its flex item values with [method set_item_flex_grow], [method set_item_flex_shrink], [method set_item_flex_basis], [method set_item_align_self], and [method set_item_order]. In the Inspector, these values are also exposed as dynamic properties under [code]flex_items/<child_name>/[/code]. The visual box is themed through the [theme_item normal] and [theme_item hover] [StyleBox] items. CSS padding is themed separately with [theme_item padding_top], [theme_item padding_right], [theme_item padding_bottom], and [theme_item padding_left], plus their [code]hover_padding_*[/code] variants. The effective CSS inset is the active [StyleBox]'s margin, usually the border width for [StyleBoxFlat], plus the active padding value on each side.

method.name: get_align_content
method.description: Returns how flex lines are packed along the cross axis when wrapping is enabled.

method.name: get_align_items
method.description: Returns the default cross-axis alignment used by child controls.

method.name: get_box_sizing
method.description: Returns whether [member size] is interpreted like CSS [code]content-box[/code] or [code]border-box[/code].

method.name: get_column_gap
method.description: Returns the CSS [code]column-gap[/code] in pixels.

method.name: get_flex_direction
method.description: Returns the main axis and direction used to place flex items.

method.name: get_flex_wrap
method.description: Returns whether child controls are forced onto one line or can wrap onto multiple lines.

method.name: get_item_align_self
method.description: Returns [param child]'s cross-axis alignment override. [constant ALIGN_SELF_AUTO] uses [member align_items].

method.name: get_item_flex_basis
method.description: Returns [param child]'s flex base size in pixels. A negative value means CSS [code]auto[/code].

method.name: get_item_flex_grow
method.description: Returns [param child]'s CSS [code]flex-grow[/code] factor.

method.name: get_item_flex_shrink
method.description: Returns [param child]'s CSS [code]flex-shrink[/code] factor.

method.name: get_item_order
method.description: Returns [param child]'s CSS [code]order[/code] value.

method.name: get_justify_content
method.description: Returns how free space is distributed along the main axis.

method.name: get_row_gap
method.description: Returns the CSS [code]row-gap[/code] in pixels.

method.name: set_align_content
method.description: Sets how flex lines are packed along the cross axis when wrapping is enabled.

method.name: set_align_items
method.description: Sets the default cross-axis alignment used by child controls.

method.name: set_box_sizing
method.description: Sets whether [member size] is interpreted like CSS [code]content-box[/code] or [code]border-box[/code].

method.name: set_column_gap
method.description: Sets the CSS [code]column-gap[/code] in pixels.

method.name: set_flex_direction
method.description: Sets the main axis and direction used to place flex items.

method.name: set_flex_wrap
method.description: Sets whether child controls are forced onto one line or can wrap onto multiple lines.

method.name: set_item_align_self
method.description: Sets [param child]'s cross-axis alignment override. Use [constant ALIGN_SELF_AUTO] to inherit [member align_items].

method.name: set_item_flex_basis
method.description: Sets [param child]'s flex base size in pixels. Use a negative value for CSS [code]auto[/code].

method.name: set_item_flex_grow
method.description: Sets [param child]'s CSS [code]flex-grow[/code] factor.

method.name: set_item_flex_shrink
method.description: Sets [param child]'s CSS [code]flex-shrink[/code] factor.

method.name: set_item_order
method.description: Sets [param child]'s CSS [code]order[/code] value. Lower values are placed first, with scene order used as a tie-breaker.

method.name: set_justify_content
method.description: Sets how free space is distributed along the main axis.

method.name: set_row_gap
method.description: Sets the CSS [code]row-gap[/code] in pixels.

members.member: Controls CSS [code]align-content[/code] for multi-line flex containers.

Items are placed vertically in reverse main-axis order, like CSS [code]column-reverse[/code].
All items stay on a single flex line, like CSS [code]nowrap[/code].
Items can wrap onto multiple lines, like CSS [code]wrap[/code].
Items can wrap onto multiple lines with reversed cross-axis stacking, like CSS [code]wrap-reverse[/code].

[member size] is treated as the CSS content box. The active [StyleBox] is drawn around it.
[member size] is treated as the CSS border box. The flex content area is reduced by the active [StyleBox]'s margins plus the active padding theme constants.

theme_items.theme_item: The CSS box used when the mouse is not hovering this container. Use [StyleBoxFlat] for background, solid border, border radius, and a single box shadow. CSS padding is controlled by the [theme_item padding_top], [theme_item padding_right], [theme_item padding_bottom], and [theme_item padding_left] constants.
The CSS box used while the mouse is hovering this container. If unset, [theme_item normal] is used.

The CSS [code]box-sizing[/code] mode. [code]0[/code] means [constant BOX_SIZING_CONTENT_BOX], matching the browser default [code]content-box[/code]: [member size] is the content box and the active [StyleBox] plus padding are drawn around it. [code]1[/code] means [constant BOX_SIZING_BORDER_BOX], matching CSS [code]border-box[/code]: [member size] includes the active [StyleBox]'s border margins and the active padding constants, and the flex content area is reduced by those values.
The CSS [code]opacity[/code] used when not hovered, from [code]0[/code] transparent to [code]1000[/code] opaque.
The CSS [code]opacity[/code] used while hovered, from [code]0[/code] transparent to [code]1000[/code] opaque.
The normal-state CSS [code]padding-top[/code] in pixels. Browser default is [code]0[/code].
The normal-state CSS [code]padding-right[/code] in pixels. Browser default is [code]0[/code].
The normal-state CSS [code]padding-bottom[/code] in pixels. Browser default is [code]0[/code].
The normal-state CSS [code]padding-left[/code] in pixels. Browser default is [code]0[/code].

The CSS [code]padding-top[/code] in pixels while the mouse is hovering this container. Use [code]-1[/code] to inherit [theme_item padding_top], matching CSS hover behavior when padding is not overridden.

The CSS [code]padding-right[/code] in pixels while the mouse is hovering this container. Use [code]-1[/code] to inherit [theme_item padding_right], matching CSS hover behavior when padding is not overridden.

The CSS [code]padding-bottom[/code] in pixels while the mouse is hovering this container. Use [code]-1[/code] to inherit [theme_item padding_bottom], matching CSS hover behavior when padding is not overridden.

The CSS [code]padding-left[/code] in pixels while the mouse is hovering this container. Use [code]-1[/code] to inherit [theme_item padding_left], matching CSS hover behavior when padding is not overridden.
